task: Check account balances across all linked bank accounts
description: The user wants to see the current balances for their checking, savings, and investment accounts, including pending transactions that might affect available balance.

task: Transfer money from savings to checking to cover an upcoming bill
description: The user needs to transfer $2,500 from their savings account to their checking account before a mortgage payment is auto-debited tomorrow, and wants confirmation of the transfer.

task: Pay multiple utility bills in one session
description: The user wants to pay their electricity, water, and internet bills from their checking account, viewing each bill amount and due date before confirming payments.

task: Check the performance of an investment portfolio
description: The user wants to review their stock portfolio performance over the past 3 months, see individual stock gains/losses, overall return percentage, and compare against the S&P 500 benchmark.

task: Inquire about personal loan options and eligibility
description: The user wants to explore personal loan options for a $15,000 home renovation, comparing interest rates, loan terms, monthly payment estimates, and checking their pre-qualification status.

task: Apply for a new credit card with travel rewards
description: The user wants to compare travel rewards credit cards, understand annual fees, sign-up bonuses, foreign transaction fees, and lounge access benefits, then submit an application for the preferred card.

task: Review transaction history and identify suspicious charges
description: The user noticed an unfamiliar charge on their credit card and wants to review the last 30 days of transactions, identify any other suspicious charges, and flag them for investigation.

task: Set up a monthly budget and categorize expenses
description: The user wants to create a monthly budget based on their income, categorize last month's spending into housing, food, transport, entertainment, and savings, and identify areas to cut back.

task: Convert USD to EUR and find the best exchange rate
description: The user is traveling to Europe and wants to convert $3,000 to euros, comparing exchange rates from their bank, online services, and airport kiosks, and lock in the best rate.

task: Estimate quarterly tax payment for freelance income
description: The user is a freelancer who earned $28,000 in Q1 and needs to estimate their quarterly tax payment, accounting for deductible business expenses of $5,000 and self-employment tax.

task: Set up automatic recurring transfers to a savings goal
description: The user wants to save $6,000 for a vacation over the next 12 months by setting up automatic weekly transfers from checking to a dedicated savings account.

task: Refinance a mortgage and compare offers
description: The user has a 30-year mortgage at 6.5% and wants to explore refinancing options, comparing rates from multiple lenders, estimating closing costs, and calculating break-even points.

task: Dispute a charge and request a chargeback
description: The user purchased a product online that was never delivered and wants to dispute the $350 charge on their credit card, providing order details and initiating a formal chargeback process.

task: Analyze spending trends over the past year
description: The user wants to see a breakdown of their spending trends over the past 12 months, identify months with unusually high spending, and see category-level changes over time.

task: Open a new high-yield savings account
description: The user wants to compare high-yield savings accounts from online banks, looking at APY rates, minimum balance requirements, withdrawal limits, and FDIC insurance, then open the best option.

task: Set up bill reminders and autopay for recurring expenses
description: The user wants to see all their recurring bills, set up autopay for fixed-amount bills, and create reminders for variable bills that need review before payment.
